'''Pyropup''' is a [[Fire]] type [[Guardian]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Pyrohound]] at 6 bronze stars.

==Overview==
Current Description: "The brightness of the small flame on the tail is an indicator of Pyropup's mood. When Pyropup is excited, the flame can even set grass alight."

Pyropup is a purple rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A small, black dog with a tan lower face, eyebrows, and paws. It has red inner ears, a flame colored tail, a bright orange nose and red tongue that sticks out. It has white eyes with brown-black pupils. 

Pyropup's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces its red inner ears and flame colored tail with purple and blue.

==Evolution Trial==
Pyropup's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 bronze stars. To evolve it into [[Pyrohound]] you need to complete the following task:
* Feed Pyropup 30 cookies.

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 2/10/2026, its bio used to say: "Pyropup roams freely, marking whatever territory it wants. Now you don't need to pick up its poop."
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "I. Pyropup tails can act as a lighter, but be mindful of how often you use it. II. Do not smoke. --- Pyropup Safety Care Manual"

== Strategy ==
[[File:Pyropup Attack Range.png|x200px|left|thumb|Pyropup's attack range]]
Strong frontline Fire type. Better than [[Ashlarva]] as a Tank, but when paired with Ashlarva/evos and a good Fire DPS such as [[Sparkit]]/evos, they can easily clear a Grass wave.
{{clear|left}}
